post.summary: Generate invoice XML from typed invoice data
post.description:
Produces deterministic CII (Factur-X, ZUGFeRD) or UBL (XRechnung) XML from a typed invoice document. Tax groups and totals are calculated by PVAD. Requires the `designer.pdf.e-invoices.generate` permission and the `generator` product entitlement. The JSON request body is limited to 2 MiB.
### Validation states

PVAD reports three independent states and never merges them:

| State | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Structural recognition | `isStructurallyValid` | The XML parsed under a bounded, DTD-free reader and was recognised as CII or UBL with a declared guideline identifier. It is **not** a conformance claim. |
| PVAD business validation | `diagnostics` with `PXAEINV...` codes | PVAD's own checks, for example profile/standard agreement and arithmetic totals. |
| Official conformance | `isConformanceValidated`, `conformanceStatus` | `validated`, `invalid` or `notEvaluated`, produced only by a pinned official XSD/Schematron artifact set that is identified by `validatorArtifactSetId` and `validatorArtifactSetSha256`. `notEvaluated` means no artifact set was configured for that standard, version, profile and syntax. |

An invoice is never reported as conformant on the strength of structural validation alone.

facturX.description: A French/European hybrid invoice in UN/CEFACT CII syntax.

zugferd.description: The German product identity of the same technical hybrid format. Its XML is embedded as factur-x.xml and uses the Factur-X XMP namespace.

xrechnung.description: German public-sector invoicing in UBL syntax. Embedding it in a PDF is a PVAD workflow, not a requirement of the standard.

post.summary: Attach invoice XML to an existing PDF
post.description:
Embeds validated invoice XML into a PDF that already exists. A source that already identifies PDF/A-3b receives an incremental update, so the original bytes are the prefix of the result and no visible page can change. A source whose archival identification forbids embedded files is converted to PDF/A-3b first, which rewrites the file and therefore requires `allowArchiveConversion=true`. Modifying a signed document requires `allowSignatureInvalidation=true`: a rewrite removes its signatures, while an incremental attachment preserves the signed bytes but adds a later revision. Replacing an existing invoice attachment (`replaceExistingInvoice`) and attaching an invoice whose values were not found in the visible page (`allowInconsistentPdf`) each require their own explicit approval. Blocked operations return `409` with the full preflight report and never modify the source. Requires the `designer.pdf.e-invoices.attach` permission and the `generator` entitlement; the source PDF is limited to 100 MiB, the invoice XML to 10 MiB and the result to 120 MiB.
### Validation states

PVAD reports three independent states and never merges them:

| State | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Structural recognition | `isStructurallyValid` | The XML parsed under a bounded, DTD-free reader and was recognised as CII or UBL with a declared guideline identifier. It is **not** a conformance claim. |
| PVAD business validation | `diagnostics` with `PXAEINV...` codes | PVAD's own checks, for example profile/standard agreement and arithmetic totals. |
| Official conformance | `isConformanceValidated`, `conformanceStatus` | `validated`, `invalid` or `notEvaluated`, produced only by a pinned official XSD/Schematron artifact set that is identified by `validatorArtifactSetId` and `validatorArtifactSetSha256`. `notEvaluated` means no artifact set was configured for that standard, version, profile and syntax. |

CellBorderSideDto.description: A single cell border side (carries source designers' per-side pens, e.g. RDL/ActiveReports).

value.description: The literal value (text/number/bool/date) or, for a formula cell, its last computed value.

formula.description: An A1 formula starting with '=', e.g. "=SUM(A1:A10)". Set when string CellDto.Type = "formula".

oneOf.description:
Cell styling. Reuses CellStyleDto; its Row/Col are unused here (this cell's own
            int CellDto.Row/int CellDto.Col are authoritative).

CellDto.description: A single sparse cell. int CellDto.Row/int CellDto.Col are 0-based.

borderColor.description: Uniform border for all four sides; per-side overrides win when present.

CellStyleDto.description:
Per-cell table styling. Sparse: addressed by int CellStyleDto.Row/int CellStyleDto.Col; any unset
            property falls back to the table-level default (header bg, zebra, column alignment).

color.description: Fill color applied when the rule matches (cellIs), or the high color (colorScale/dataBar).

ConditionalFormatDto.description: A conditional-formatting rule over a range. (Export to .xlsx; import is best-effort.)

listSource.description: For list: comma-separated allowed values, or an A1 range reference.

DataValidationDto.description: A data-validation rule over a range. (Export to .xlsx; import is best-effort.)

assetId.description:
Stable package-local image reference in a PVADP document. Persistent Designer documents
replace this value with an organization-owned asset ID after import.

langOverrides.description: Per-language position/rotation overrides. Key = BCP-47 tag (e.g. "de", "ar").

tocPlacement.description: "beginning" | "end" — only used when the TOC element controls a separate TOC page.

tocEntries.description: Pre-computed TOC entries from the frontend "Update TOC" action.

ElementDto.description: Maps directly to the frontend SimpleElement type.

LangOverrideDto.description: Per-language position and rotation override for a canvas element.

scope.description: "global" = exists in all languages (each fills its own value); "own" = exists only for OwnerLanguage.

ownerLanguage.description: Set only when Scope == "own". Identifies the single language that owns this property.

targetLanguage.description: When set in the exported JSON, overrides the API query-param language for this export.

PageSetupDto.description: Print / page setup for a sheet.

PdfEInvoiceAttachmentStrategy.description: How an invoice attachment is written into an existing PDF.

PdfRedactionAuditRecord.description:
Evidence that a redaction happened, carrying hashes and region geometry but never the
removed content. string PdfRedactionAuditRecord.RecordSha256 covers the record's own canonical form, so a
later change to it is detectable. Deployments can additionally attach a dedicated audit
signature to prove origin.

PdfRedactionAuditSignature.description:
A detached CMS signature over string PdfRedactionAuditRecord.RecordSha256, and the
identity that produced it. The signature covers the record's canonical hash, so it proves
both origin and that the record has not changed.

PdfRedactionCapability.description:
What PVAD can promise for a region or a document. Unknown is never folded into
PdfRedactionCapability.Removable.

PdfRedactionCoveredContent.description:
Evidence for one kind of covered content. Counts and measurements only: the covered
text itself never enters the report.

PdfRedactionRegion.description: A region to analyse, in PDF user-space coordinates for the given page.

ProtectionDto.description: Sheet protection (read-only cells except where unlocked).

oneOf.description: The validator's own finding, when this diagnostic came from an official artifact set.

source.description: Which validation step produced it, for example `xsd` or `schematron`.

ruleId.description: The rule or assertion identifier, when the artifact set supplies one.

severity.description: The validator's own severity, not PVAD's.

location.description: Where in the document the validator pointed, typically an XPath or line.

test.description: The assertion expression, when the artifact set supplies one.

PvadEInvoiceOriginalFinding.description: One finding exactly as the official validator reported it.

RepeatDto.description: Repeat configuration — iterates a data path and stamps a template element.

width.description: Width in Excel character units (ClosedXML's column width unit).

rowCount.description: Logical grid extent (the editor may show more; cells are sparse).

cells.description: Sparse cells — only non-empty/styled cells are present.

merges.description: Merged ranges in A1 notation, e.g. "A1:B2".

autoFilterRange.description: Range (A1) the auto-filter dropdowns cover, e.g. "A1:D20".

images.description: Images anchored to worksheet cells. Persisted documents use Guid? SpreadsheetImageDto.AssetId;

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema URL for editor/tooling validation (the `$schema` property).

schemaVersion.description: PVAD Workbook JSON format version, e.g. "1.0". Defaults so older payloads still load.

SpreadsheetDto.description: A workbook for the Spreadsheet Editor SDK — an Excel-like model distinct from the document DesignExportDto. This is the canonical PVAD Workbook JSON format (camelCase); round-trips to/from `.xlsx` (ClosedXML) preserving typed values, formulas, number formats, styles, merges, column widths, frozen panes, and defined names.

data.description: Transient import/export payload. Designer persistence replaces this with Guid? SpreadsheetImageDto.AssetId.

TocEntryDto.description: A single entry in a pre-computed Table of Contents.
